examples.scenario: An Item uses asset key dem but roles identify it as overview
examples.reason: Asset keys are non-semantic; verified roles, media type and band metadata must select the elevation data.

examples.scenario: A relative asset href is resolved from a URL missing its intended trailing slash
examples.reason: The resolved object can change when the base URI is treated as a file instead of a directory.

examples.scenario: Item-level proj:transform differs from the selected asset override
examples.reason: Asset-level projection metadata overrides the Item default and must match the opened raster.

examples.scenario: proj:shape is read as X-Y instead of Y-X
examples.reason: Swapped dimensions can create a plausible but incorrect footprint and window.

examples.scenario: STAC file:checksum verifies but file:size differs
examples.reason: All declared identity fields must agree with the same materialized blob.

examples.scenario: Catalog says raster:sampling=point while GeoTIFF semantics indicate pixel area
examples.reason: Parcel inclusion and extrema depend on whether values represent centres or areas.

examples.scenario: Collection extent intersects the parcel but the selected Item geometry does not
examples.reason: Collection extent is for discovery and does not prove asset coverage at the target.

examples.scenario: A later API replay returns the same Item ID with a different asset href
examples.reason: Mutable discovery responses cannot inherit the prior asset identity or acceptance.
